newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philrealty up 21.43 pct in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Philrealty up 21.43 pct in early trade.

text.p: Philippine Realty and Holdings Corp Philrealty rose by 30 centavos, or 21.43 percent, to 1.70 pesos in early trade on Monday on buying triggered by news of Philrealty selling its stake in Philippine Racing Club.

"Its still the story on the Malaysian firm's buyout of Philrealty's stake in Philippine Racing Club. Philrealty has raised cash and their projects are on line," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor Hagedorn Securities Inc.

"Furthermore, Philrealty is still a bargain," added Reyes. Some 82.20 million Philrealty shares changed hands in early trade, making it one of the most actively traded shares in a market where blue chips and the main index had fallen.
Philrealty sold last month 34 percent of its stake in the Philippine Racing Club to Malaysia's Leisure Management Berhad for 12 pesos a share.
The proceeds, according to Philrealty, will be used to finance in part its 2.5 billion peso building project inside Fort Bonifacio, close to Manila's financial district of Makati.
